name: pos-m1-tamper-matrix
title: POS campaign M1: tamper-class matrix harness (tamper.mjs) asserting each class matches its frozen fingerprint (H2 evidence)
description: Second milestone of the proof-or-stop replay & tamper campaign (plan: docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-evidence-instrument-replay-execution-plan.md; M0 DONE as story B-9e44, protocol frozen at experiments/pos-instrument-replay/protocol.json sha256 a3a781fe). M1 delivers experiments/pos-instrument-replay/tamper.mjs + a selfcheck: for each (class x manifestHandling) in the FROZEN protocol tamperMatrix, apply the mutation to an mkdtemp-isolated copy of a fresh baseline, run verify, and record a verdict in tamper-verdicts.jsonl with the full boolean flag vector + gold metrics + a fingerprint-match boolean + the disposition. Exit criterion (H2 evidence complete): every fail-closed-set class yields status:fail AND its observed values over the frozen fingerprint domain match the frozen per-class fingerprint; every acceptance-bucket combination matches its status:pass fingerprint; every acknowledged-limitation matches its documented status:pass blind-spot fingerprint. Reuses M0 lib/instrument.mjs (verifyDir crash sentinel, refreshManifest, canonicalJson, fingerprintDomain). The instrument (packages/**) is read/called only.
